title: lysosome report
description: Output of `lysosome <command> --json` (`scan` or `worktrees`). Versioned by schema_version; only additive changes happen within a major version, so consumers must ignore unknown properties.

scanned_roots.description: Canonical absolute paths that were scanned.

dormant_after_days.description: Idle days after which an item counts as dormant (--days).

tier.description: regenerable: cheap to rebuild, one-click safe. regenerable_expensive: rebuildable but costly to get back. review: a human must look.

status.description: ACTIVE: recently used. REMOVABLE: dormant and provably safe. REVIEW: dormant but may hold unique work. ORPHAN: owning repository is gone.

cleanup.description: How to remove the item. action "command" (the default when absent): run `command`, an argv vector — the tool's own cleanup command. action "trash": move every entry of `paths` to the Trash. Never present for items that are not safe to remove.

reclaimable_bytes.description: Total size of REMOVABLE findings: space reclaimable right now with no risk.

by_tier.description: Size of dormant (non-ACTIVE) findings per tier. Every tier is present.

by_category.description: Size of dormant (non-ACTIVE) findings per category. Every known category is present.

kind.description: Finer-grained type: "worktree"; for artifacts the folder name ("node_modules", "target", ".venv", ...).

size_bytes.description: Allocated bytes on disk (like du); hard links counted once.

reason.description: Why it has this status. Empty for ACTIVE.

last_activity.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp of last use, or null if unknown.

allOf.description: System findings (caches, AI models, containers, Xcode, Android, editors) are named.
Only REMOVABLE findings carry a cleanup command.

system_details.description: Details shared by every system finding. Kind-specific keys (model, image_id, runtime_id, package, ...) may be added.

name.description: Human name to show instead of the path: a model name (llama3.1:8b, meta-llama/Llama-3-8B), an image (web:1.0), an OS version (iOS 17.5 (21F79)), a cache (npm cache).

redownload_bytes.description: regenerable_expensive only: bytes to download to get it back (Ollama models include layers shared with other models).

shared_bytes.description: Bytes shared with other items and therefore not part of size_bytes.

unreadable_entries.description: Entries that could not be read while sizing (size_bytes may be low).

branch.description: Branch name, "(detached)", or null for orphans.

unpushed.description: Commits on HEAD that no remote has; null when the repo has no remote.

merged_into.description: Default branch HEAD is merged into, if any.

artifact_bytes.description: Bytes in git-ignored build/dependency folders inside the worktree (included in size_bytes).

artifact_details.description: A git-ignored build/dependency folder inside a project (category artifacts). Status is the project's: REMOVABLE when idle >= dormant_after_days, ACTIVE otherwise, REVIEW when no activity is known. Artifacts inside dormant worktrees are reported only as part of the worktree finding, so totals never double count.

project.description: Root of the repository (or active worktree) that owns the folder.

idle_days.description: Whole days since the project's last activity (newest of last commit and git index/HEAD/reflog mtimes); null if unknown.

relative_path.description: Folder path relative to the project root.

stale_metadata.description: A .git/worktrees/<name> record whose worktree folder is gone. Harmless; `git worktree prune` removes it.

skipped.description: What the scan could not look at (never fatal).
